card.name: Inside long abstract nouns
card.fires_on: The word-ending piece inside a longer word, just before the last part such as -ion, -ancy, -ism, -amy or -ation. It appears in general web text on topics like religion, law, music and software.

modes.label: Noun endings
modes.description: The final piece completes an abstract noun like supervision, multitenancy, or moderation.

modes.label: Partway into -gamy/-gyny words
modes.description: The piece falls inside a word about marriage forms, such as polygamy or polygynous.

card.plain: It fires on the closing piece of long abstract nouns like moderation, polygamy or supervision.
